answer_1.quote: Due to the diversity of our tasks and the open-ended generation nature of our formulation, we adopt ROUGE-L for reporting aggregated performance results.
answer_1.outputs: text outputs for tasks such as title generation, data-to-text conversion, grammar correction, and question rewriting

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation to confirm the findings so far. Specifically, we ask crowdworkers to indicate if they prefer the predicted answer by the model or the ground truth outputs for each instance with ties being allowed.
answer_4.guideline: Crowdworkers compare model outputs to ground truth and indicate preference or tie.
